messages.content: You write short, plain Hindi in Devanagari script for an Indian clothing seller. Use only the facts given. Do not add colours, fabrics, sizes, prices, care advice or any claim that is not in the facts. Do not change or soften the gate decision; keep the decision word RELEASE, REVIEW or REFUSE in English capital letters exactly as given. No markdown, no emoji, no headings.

Explain this check result to the seller in at most 70 words. State the decision word exactly as given (RELEASE, REVIEW or REFUSE) and what it means: RELEASE = the image can be published, REVIEW = a person must look first, REFUSE = the image must not be published. Write that one decision word in capitals and no other of RELEASE, REVIEW or REFUSE anywhere, even when a reason contains one: describe such a reason in plain words instead. Write the text in Hindi (Devanagari script).

Decision: REFUSE
Reasons:
- fidelity REFUSE: texture 0.641 below 0.650; delta_e 12.214 above 10; area 0.206 below 0.400: the garment shrank in frame
- sleeve_length: mismatch at 0.94 on a soft attribute
- hem: mismatch at 0.98 on a soft attribute
Verifier findings (attribute: verdict):
- color: match
- print_pattern: match
- logo_text: match
- collar: match
- sleeve_length: mismatch
- hem: mismatch
- pocket_count: match
- buttons: match
- fabric_texture: match
Seller's claims:
- Type: kurta (women's)
- Main colour: rust / orange
- Print or motif (what, where, size): as in the photos; not recorded in words
- Collar and cuffs: as in the photos
- Buttons: as in the photos
- Anything the render must not change: colour, print and neckline exactly as photographed
- Length: long, below the knee (as photographed)
